item.title: South Carolina Coach Dawn Staley Advocates for Alums in Israel Amid Iran Military Strikes
item.description: South Carolina women's basketball coach Dawn Staley is working to bring three ex-players back from Israel amid military strikes against Iran. The post South Carolina Coach Dawn Staley Advocates for Alums in Israel Amid Iran Military Strikes appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: UConn Women’s Basketball Closes Out Regular Season Undefeated, Extends Winning Streak to 47
item.description: UConn women's basketball completed its 11th undefeated NCAA regular season with Sunday's 85-49 win over St. John's. The post UConn Women’s Basketball Closes Out Regular Season Undefeated, Extends Winning Streak to 47 appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Peyton Stearns Beats Taylor Townsend to Win 2nd WTA Title at 2026 ATX Open
item.description: Peyton Stearns defeated Taylor Townsend 7-6(8), 7-5 to win the 2026 ATX Open, after Townsend reached her first WTA singles final. The post Peyton Stearns Beats Taylor Townsend to Win 2nd WTA Title at 2026 ATX Open appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: USWNT Opens 2026 SheBelieves Cup with 2-0 Win Over Argentina
item.description: The USWNT began their hunt to reclaim the SheBelieves Cup with a 2-0 victory over Argentina in Sunday's 2026 tournament opener. The post USWNT Opens 2026 SheBelieves Cup with 2-0 Win Over Argentina appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: ACC Upsets Upend 2025/26 NCAA Basketball Regular-Season Finales
item.description: Upsets ruled the ACC on Sunday, as the conference saw top seeds fall in regular-season finales — just days before NCAA basketball conference tournaments tip off. The post ACC Upsets Upend 2025/26 NCAA Basketball Regular-Season Finales appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Texas Takes Final No. 1 Seed in Latest NCAA Committee Women’s Basketball Rankings
item.description: The 2025 Final Four teams are on their way to a repeat performance, as all four earned No. 1 seeds in this week's NCAA women's basketball committee's Top 16. item.title: Unrivaled Semifinals Land in Brooklyn After 1st-Round Upsets
item.description: The 2026 Unrivaled Playoffs tipped off with a pair of upsets, as Saturday winners Vinyl and Breeze join top seeds Phantom and Mist in Monday's semifinals in Brooklyn. The post Unrivaled Semifinals Land in Brooklyn After 1st-Round Upsets appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Australia Captain Sam Kerr Lifts Matildas Over the Philippines to Open 2026 AFC Asian Cup
item.description: Australia captain Sam Kerr scored her first international goal in more than two years on Sunday, opening the 2026 AFC Asian Cup with a win. The post Australia Captain Sam Kerr Lifts Matildas Over the Philippines to Open 2026 AFC Asian Cup appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Cameroon Tops Reigning Africa Champion Nigeria in Pre-2026 WAFCON Friendly
item.description: Nigeria's Super Falcons lost 1-0 to Camerooon on Saturday, as the reigning WAFCON champions prepare for 2026 Women's Africa Cup of Nations. The post Cameroon Tops Reigning Africa Champion Nigeria in Pre-2026 WAFCON Friendly appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Spain Launches International Women’s Day Campaign Ahead of Iceland Friendly
item.description: Spain women's football team is launching its 2026 International Women's Day campaign this week, adopting the slogan "Dream Without Limits." The post Spain Launches International Women’s Day Campaign Ahead of Iceland Friendly appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
